title: Influencer Marketing Lead
description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions. 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, acting as a central hub across leadership, ensuring seamless execution of executive priorities, governance processes, internal workflows, and organizational operations. The incumbent is expected to anticipate needs, proactively improve systems, and drive efficiency across tools, processes, and leadership workflows. 

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs.

title: Billing Officer
description:
Job Description â Billing Officer

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Reporting To: Finance Manager / Accounts Manager

Experience: 2â4 years in billing, invoicing, or accounts-related roles

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, bills, credit notes, debit notes, and related billing documents.
  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Product Engineer — Working Student
Android Engineer - Engagement Mission
Field Marketing Manager
description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

FLUX gets attention the moment people see it. Your job is to turn that attention into pipeline.

You'll own two motions where FLUX meets enterprises and partners in person: the events where customers experience the models firsthand, and the co-marketing engine with cloud and distribution partners who bring FLUX to the market. You’ll work directly with GTM, Partnerships, and our creative technologists. Our release cadence means there’s always a new reason to show up. Your job is to make sure we show up well and that every appearance has a number attached to it in order to effectively measure impact.

What you’ll work on

Events

  • Shape BFL's event calendar end-to-end: tier the opportunities, decide where we show up, and run the full events lifecycle: booths, demos, speaker slots, exec briefings, side events, follow up and more

  • Design event experiences that demonstrate the models, not just talk about them; working with Creative Technologists and FDEs on interactive demos and installations

  • Build the pre/post event machine: target lists for Sales, meeting orchestration on-site, pipeline attribution afterward. Every event has a number attached to measure impact (MQL’s)

  • Run BFL-hosted formats: customer dinners, launch events, and executive roundtables in key markets, plus side events at major moments (GTC, research oriented, etc.)

Co-marketing with partners

  • Own the co-marketing motion with our distribution and cloud partners; joint announcements, launch-day amplification, case studies, shared event presence

  • Coordinate partner marketing calendars around BFL launches so every major release lands with multiplied reach

  • Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks per partner tier, and negotiate marketing commitments into partnership conversations alongside the Partnerships team

GTM Enablement

  • Pitch decks

  • Solution marketing

Connecting the motions

  • Co-own the activation calendar with our social marketing team so events, partner moments, and social land together

  • Feed what you learn on the floor (what lands, the questions enterprises actually ask back into GTM and product marketing)

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6 years in field/event marketing, partner marketing, or integrated campaigns at a B2B tech company

  • You've run events end-to-end (from a 10-person exec dinner to a major conference presence) and can show the pipeline they produced

  • You've done co-marketing with large partners

  • You understand enterprise marketing: how buying committees work, what an exec briefing needs to accomplish, why attribution matters

  • 80%+ execution. You can build the run-of-show, brief the booth staff, etc.

  • Strong visual taste: our outputs are judged visually, and so are our activations

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, tight timelines, and launch weeks where everything happens at once

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience marketing generative AI, creative tooling, or developer-facing infrastructure

  • Existing relationships in the creative AI community

  • Experience working with cloud or platform partners on joint GTM

  • You've built an event or campaign that people in the industry still reference

  • Time spent working in the US, or in a role with significant US market ownership

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your location, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

US $160,000- $200,000 + equity
EU €105,000- €130,000 + equity

description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to move beyond traditional Excel modeling and define the future of data-driven finance operations?

Are you ready to be a key architect of the financial narrative for a high-growth SaaS business backed by world-class PE investors?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve and the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy by evolving our FP&A infrastructure for the next stage of scale. This is not a 'run the model and report back' role; we want someone who interrogates the numbers, surfaces the story behind them, and is willing to challenge assumptions at every level of the organisation.

Please note: This is a 12 month maternity cover.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Visibility: Build, maintain, and present meaningful dashboards and reports (e.g., Monthly Flash, Management Pack, Board Pack) that enable the Board, CFO, and Head of FP&A to monitor performance and take action.

  • Modernize the Stack: Support the migration of our FP&A tool/platform by defining requirements, mapping data flows, validating systems, and training stakeholders.

  • Architect Planning Frameworks: Implement end-to-end forecasting and budgeting templates and processes to enable efficient, accurate quarterly and annual planning cycles.

  • Define the Truth: Partner with the Data team to validate SaaS KPIs, ensuring a single version of truth across all business reporting.

  • Sales & Marketing Partnering: Support pipeline-to-forecast conversion modeling and commission tracking for Sales, while collaborating with Marketing to optimize segment profitability and ROI.

  • Operational Ownership: Manage and forecast global OPEX directly with department heads and support the Accounting team with month-end reviews and ad-hoc strategic business cases.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • The Foundation: Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FP&A, business finance, or a similar analytical role, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.

  • The "Scar Tissue": Proven track record of building complex financial models and managing investor-grade reporting (Private Equity/PE experience is a significant plus).

  • The Builder: Experience with platform/tool migrations (FP&A or ERP systems) and a history of driving process improvements.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • AI & Automation: Proven track record of leveraging AI-driven tools and methodologies to streamline analytical workflows and optimize repetitive tasks.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • The Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your workstreams and drive change in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

description:
🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

🤔 About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s social media channels end to end, from strategy and calendar to publishing and community, with Instagram and our primary channels front and centre.

  • Be the main creative force behind our marketing campaigns: come up with the idea, shape the story, and make it show up consistently across every channel.

  • Own the content calendar and keep every channel in sync, so campaigns land as one coherent story rather than scattered posts.

  • Plan and run campaigns end to end: the brief, the timeline, the assets, the launch, and the follow-through.

  • Run "The Modern Jewellers Playbook", our newsletter. Own the cadence and the sends, and tie it into everything else we are publishing.

  • Turn our bigger content moments, like interviews, launches, and guides, into a steady stream of social-first content that travels.

  • Write social and short-form copy that sounds like a real person and makes independent jewellers stop scrolling.

  • Work with our designer and video partners to ship content that looks as good as it reads, and with our paid marketer to amplify what is working.

  • Be the connective tissue across marketing: link events, campaigns, and content so nothing happens in a silo.

  • Track what performs across channels and use it to sharpen the calendar. Double down on what lands, and drop what does not.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 4+ years running social and content for a brand, with real ownership of channels and campaigns rather than just scheduling posts.

  • You are a storyteller first. You know how to take an idea and make it land as a post, an email, a thread, or a reel.

  • A body of social and campaign work you are proud of, ideally including channels you grew yourself.

  • You can write. Quickly, well, and in a voice that sounds human rather than corporate.

  • Sharp project management. You can run a content calendar and several campaigns at once without dropping any threads.

  • Comfort working hands-on on a small team and building process where none exists.

  • Fluent with the tools of modern social and content work, and happy to lean on AI to move faster.

  • An instinct for what performs, and the discipline to let data settle the debates.

 

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the jewelry industry

  • Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade and craft audience.

  • Hands-on with short-form video: you can shoot and cut a reel yourself, or confidently direct someone who can.

  • Experience running an email or newsletter program.

  • Community-building experience, online or off.

 

Our culture and what we offer

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

 

Our current benefits

  • 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.

Please submit your CV in English.

 

Not quite the right role?

If this role isn't for you but you're excited about Nivoda, join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something's a better fit: nivoda.com/talent-pool

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team in Berlin or remotely from Germany. In this role, you will design, build, and scale high-performance backend systems using modern Java technologies and cloud-native architectures.

You will work on complex systems where reliability, clean architecture, and strong engineering standards matter, helping Atolls build backend services that can support growth across markets and platforms.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Java Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java 17 or other recent versions (11+).
  • Build and evolve microservice-based and event-driven architectures
  • Develop APIs using GraphQL
  • Work with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive (WebFlux)
  • Design and optimize data models using MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability of backend systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Implement performance testing and end-to-end testing
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical best practices
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership when needed
  • Collaborate on AI-enabled features, including prompt engineering and backend integrations

 Your Profile:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in backend development
  • Strong expertise in Java 17 or other recent versions (11+)
  • Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive
  • Solid knowledge of MySQL and experience with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of microservice architecture and event-driven systems
  • Experience building and consuming GraphQL APIs
  • Proven experience with performance optimization and testing
  • Experience with end-to-end testing strategies
  • Experience with prompt engineering for AI-powered applications
  • Excellent understanding of software design and architectural patterns
  • Ability to design elegant, scalable, and maintainable system architectures
  • Strong communication skills and excellent English proficiency

 Bonus points: 

  • Cloud experience (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience building AI-integrated backend systems

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

title: Founding Engineer - Fullstack (m/w/d)
description:
nuuEnergy - Das sind WIR!

nuuEnergy hat es sich zur Mission gemacht, die Wärmewende anzuführen, die Europa dringend braucht!

Wir sind ein Climate-Tech-Start-up aus München und revolutionieren Wärmepumpeninstallationen: mit smarten End-to-End-Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen, ehrlichem Handwerk, regionalen Teams und Anlagen, die wirklich funktionieren.

Mit unserem ganzheitlichen Angebot ermöglichen wir es unseren Kund:innen, Emissionen in ihren eigenen vier Wänden aktiv zu reduzieren und langfristig Kosten zu sparen.

Was uns besonders macht? Unsere Kombination aus Start-up-Dynamik, Handwerksstolz und echter Sinnhaftigkeit.

Jetzt suchen wir dich als Founding Engineer - Fullstack (m/w/d) im Handwerk, um gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Schritte zu gehen und nuuEnergy weiter aufzubauen.


Deine Aufgaben

Du bist Builder:

Du baust täglich Code, der Baustellen profitabler und Handwerkern den Job leichter macht. Und du bist die Person, bei der technische Qualität zusammenläuft.

  • Features end-to-end bauen. DB-Schema, API-Route, Frontend, vom Web-Cockpit bis in die Mobile Apps. Du lieferst das Ganze, nicht nur einen Layer. Die Reise vom Ticket zur Production ist bei uns kurz.
  • Code-Reviews übernehmen. Ein großer Teil unseres Codes entsteht mit Claude Code. Du reviewst, was reingeht, erkennst die Stellen, an denen ein Modell halluziniert oder schludert, und sorgst dafür, dass Tempo nicht auf Kosten der Codebase geht.
  • Architekturentscheidungen auf API-Ebene treffen. Wie schneiden wir Endpoints, wie designen wir Auth und Berechtigungen, wie strukturieren wir das Datenmodell für mehrere Hubs. Wie wir in unserem Stack bauen, entscheidest du maßgeblich.
  • KI-Tools als Hebel nutzen. Claude Code und Cursor sind bei uns Alltag. Du weißt, wann sie dich schneller machen und wann du selbst ran musst.
  • Mitdenken, bevor du baust. Wenn eine Spec technisch oder wirtschaftlich keinen Sinn ergibt, sagst du das, bevor du sie umsetzt. Du verstehst, worauf unsere Features einzahlen (Marge pro Baustelle, Handwerker-Adoption) und hinterfragst, was darauf nicht einzahlt.

Wie du aufgehangen bist: Du bist Teil des Product-Teams. Es gibt keine eigene Dev-Abteilung, sondern ein kleines Team, das Konzept, Build und Betrieb gemeinsam verantwortet und entsprechend eng zusammenarbeitet.

Was die Rolle nicht ist: Kein Product Management, keine Konzeptarbeit, kein Stakeholder-Management, keine Führungsverantwortung. Priorisierung und Produktentscheidungen liegen beim Product-Team. Du bist die Execution- und Qualitätsinstanz, nicht der nächste PM.

Unser Tech-Stack:
  • Web & API: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19), TypeScript strict, TanStack React Query, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, PWA via Serwist
  • Mobile Apps: React Native mit Expo (drei Apps: Bauleiter, Aufmaßtechniker, Monteure)
  • Backend & DB: Supabase (Postgres, Storage, Realtime)
  • Auth: NextAuth 5 mit Supabase als User-Store
  • Monitoring: Sentry
  • Automation: n8n (self-hosted)
  • Legacy, wird abgelöst: Airtable
  • Integrationen: HubSpot, Lexware, Slack, Autarc


Dein Profil

Uns interessieren Skills, nicht Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.

  • TypeScript und React/Next.js in Produktion gebaut, nicht nur in Side-Projects
  • React Native (Expo) Erfahrung oder die Fähigkeit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten
  • SQL und Postgres auf einem Niveau, auf dem du selbst Schemas designst, Indices setzt und Migrations mit laufendem Betrieb durchziehst
  • API-Design-Erfahrung über Standard-CRUD hinaus: Authorization-Modelle, Idempotenz, saubere Fehlerbehandlung
  • Du hast ernsthaft mit KI-Tools gearbeitet (Claude Code, Cursor oder vergleichbar). Features, die damit entstanden sind, stehen in Produktion. Und du kannst erklären, was du dabei selbst entschieden hast.
  • Du kannst Code-Reviews führen, die andere besser machen, statt sie zu demotivieren
  • Du kannst zeigen, was du gebaut hast: GitHub, Live-Produkt, irgendwas Greifbares
Was uns wichtig ist

description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.

Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.

Why Strong Sellers Join Singu

  • A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.

  • Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.

  • Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.

  • Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.

What You Will Own

Pipeline and Coverage

  • A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.

  • Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.

  • Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.

Deal Execution

  • Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

  • Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

  • Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

  • By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.

  • The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.

  • A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.

  • CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.

Package, Support and Progression

  • Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.

  • Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen.

Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften.

Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen!

Deine Mission

Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt.

Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe.

  • Du durchsichtest sorgfältig Betriebsdokumenten wie Agraranträge, Ackerschlagkartei, Düngebedarfsermittlungen, Saatgutbelege, Dienstleistungsrechnungen und Inventarlisten und überprüfst, dass die Datenlage auf unserer Plattform in Einklang mit der Dokumentation steht.

  • Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung.

  • Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen.

  • Mit deiner Arbeit stellst du sicher, dass die von unserem Modell berechneten CO₂-Einspeicherungen und Einsparungen tatsächlich erreicht wurden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund

  • Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

  • Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Deine Benefits

  • Growth: Einblicke in alle Arbeitsbereiche eines agilen Start-Ups und wertvolles Wissen über die moderne Arbeitswelt.

  • Opportunity: Arbeite bei einem innovativen Unternehmen für regenerative Landwirtschaft und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Ziele erreichen.

  • Impact: Dein Engagement trägt täglich zur Zukunftssicherheit der Landwirtschaft, zur Bodengesundheit und zum Klimaschutz bei.

  • Autonomy: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Wir fördern flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten und ermöglichen es dir, aus unserem Berliner Büro oder remote zu arbeiten.

  • Weitere Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen in Deutschland: Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket, Team-Lunches (in Berlin) sowie regelmäßige Team-Events.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Bei Klim sind wir überzeugt, dass ein lebendiger und erfolgreicher Arbeitsplatz auf den vielfältigen Hintergründen, Talenten und Perspektiven unseres Teams basiert. Gemeinsam werden wir stärker, indem wir die individuellen Stärken jeder einzelnen Person wertschätzen und weiterentwickeln.

Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle geschätzt fühlen und die Möglichkeit haben, ihr volles Potenzial einzubringen. title: Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration
description:
Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration

Als Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance Integration & Projektmanagement:

    • Management der Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie.

    • Steuerung und Koordination gruppenweiter Finance-Projekte und Integrationsinitiativen.

    • Begleitung unserer Tochtergesellschaften bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme

    • Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen, Sicherstellung der Projektfortschritte sowie aktives Eskalationsmanagement.

  • Zusammenarbeit & Standardisierung:

    • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem VP Finance Operations, unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften.

    • Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Finance-Standards, Prozesse und Reporting-Strukturen.

    • Koordination zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.

    • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungspotenzialen innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft.


Deine Startvoraussetzungen

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen

    • Erfahrung in der Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern; Erfahrung in Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO-Office oder Consulting ist von Vorteil

    • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv zu begleiten und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen

    • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Erfahrungen im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) oder in eine PE-backed bzw. wachstumsstarken Unternehmensumfeld sind von Vorteil

Unsere Benefits

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.

  • Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung über unser Stellenportal. Nach der Prüfung Deines CVs wartet ein dreistufiger Bewerbungsprozess auf dich. Dieser startet mit einem kurzen Telefonat mit Allen, Senior Group Talent Acquisition Partner, gefolgt von einem Video-Call mit dem Fachbereich. Anschließend besteht die Möglichkeit, das Team sowie die verschiedenen Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereiche der Stelle vor Ort besser kennenzulernen. Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise!

title: Senior IGA Consultant, Identity Governance and Access Controls
description:
Intelance is building a trusted associate team for identity governance and access control work in regulated and complex organisations.

We are looking for a Senior IGA Consultant to turn access evidence into clear findings, practical access rules and delivery ready actions. The first likely assignment supports a financial services client reviewing who can see and change sensitive client information across Microsoft, data and business platforms.

This is an associate contract. Work is assigned through paid work orders after client approval. The first assignment is expected to be a focused number of delivery days, with the possibility of later pilot, access review and recurring governance work.

Tasks

Working with the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant, you will:

• Analyse user, group, role, permission and service account exports.

• Reconcile technical access with the business reason for access.

• Identify broad, stale, direct and conflicting access, and record the evidence for each point.

• Carry out role mining and draft role and access matrices.

• Test joiner, role change and leaver controls, including where old access is removed.

• Draft clear findings that state the system, affected access, evidence, risk and required decision.

• Support access reviews and certification so business owners can make informed decisions.

• Review privileged accounts, service accounts and integration identities.

• Support access testing for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and connected business systems.

• Maintain the findings register, evidence record and implementation backlog.

• Support pilot testing and confirm that completed changes match the approved design.

You will not be expected to act as the overall design authority. The Principal IAM Consultant owns the target access design and final technical challenge.

Requirements

Essential:

• Strong recent experience delivering identity governance or access control work in a complex organisation.

• Hands on experience analysing users, groups, roles, permissions and access grants.

• Practical role mining and role based access control experience.

• Experience designing or operating access reviews, certification and recertification.

• Experience testing joiner, role change and leaver controls.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions.

• Experience reviewing privileged accounts, service accounts or integration access.

• Able to write short, evidence based findings in plain English.

• Comfortable working independently from source records and recorded interviews.

• Based in the United Kingdom and available during UK business hours.

• Available for short, clearly scoped assignments that may grow after client approval.

Strong advantage:

• Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business.

• Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.

• Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or another identity governance platform.

• Experience of segregation of duties analysis.

• Experience reviewing AI tools or connectors that can reach company information.

• Relevant Microsoft identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 certification.

Please apply only if you have personally analysed access evidence and turned it into findings or role design. General project coordination or user administration alone is not enough.

Benefits

  • • Indicative rate of £425 to £500 per day, depending on the assignment and depth of relevant experience.
  • • Fully remote work within the United Kingdom.
  • • Clear work orders, agreed days and defined outputs before each assignment starts.
  • • Direct access to the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant.
  • • Focused work on real access problems in regulated organisations.
  • • Potential follow on work across design, pilot delivery, access reviews and recurring governance.
  • • Prompt payment against agreed timesheets and completed work.

Please submit your CV and answer the application questions fully.

We will first check whether your recent work matches the evidence analysis and role design needed. Suitable candidates will then have a short screening call and a structured technical discussion based on a real access scenario.

This is an associate opportunity. No minimum number of days is guaranteed. Each assignment is subject to client approval, an agreed work order and confirmed delivery dates.

Our clinics are where Neko shows up most tangibly – for our members and for our teams. Nowhere carries more of that than the UK: currently our largest clinical market, and the clearest test of whether our people practices hold up under real growth. As UK Lead, this role owns the full people strategy behind how the UK scales: what the organisation looks like, how clinic teams are shaped and staffed, how people are led, developed, and rewarded, and what it feels like to work here. It also carries the embedded, day-to-day work of keeping clinics running well today. Both, at the same time, and neither at arm's length.

Own the clinical people agenda for the UK

  • Be the day-to-day People partner across UK clinical leadership – senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers – owning workforce planning, organisational design, and talent decisions for the clinical population

Be embedded in clinics

  • Spend real time in clinics to understand how work actually happens – not just what's written down

Help clinic leaders lead well

Data-informed, judgement-led, moving at the pace of the business

Hold both hats: UK delivery and global clinical strategy

  • Data Management: Prepare, clean, and integrate datasets from various sources, ensuring data quality and accuracy. Collaborate with Data Engineers to build and maintain scalable data pipelines for efficient analysis.

  • Support for Clinical Studies: Collaborate with clinical teams to define targeted clinical hypotheses, study variables and collection methods for clinical studies. Perform exploratory analyses and provide data insights to refine study designs.

  • Research and Innovation: Stay up-to-date on data science advances to continuously improve model accuracy, efficiency, and clinical relevance. Develop proofs-of-concept of new medical devices and methods. Support patent development.

  • Maintenance, scaling, and common tooling: Improve robustness of products, streamlining of processes and increasing efficiency of data science development by applying good software engineering practices.

Requirements:

  • MSc or PhD degree in a quantitative field for example Computer Science, Machine Learning or Physics.

  • Expertise within data science, algorithm development, and statistics.

  • Strong analytical abilities, collaborative mindset, and solid software engineering skills.

  • A strong proficiency in designing and implementing machine learning algorithms.

About the Engineering Team

 

Distributed and Remote First

We are nearly 100 full time engineers at the company, working from Berlin, Chamonix, Hamburg, Lisbon, Marseille, Vilnius, and Stockholm, spanning diverse disciplines such as Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Electrical Design, Algorithm Development, Machine Learning Development, Optronics Research, Frontend Development and more. We don't expect people to join us with a specific tech knowledge, but we do expect you to work with our tools. We use a mix of React, Typescript, C++, and Python. Our APIs are written in C# with ASP.NET Core, uses Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Active Directory for authentication. 

 

Our headquarters and our hardware development team are in Stockholm, Sweden.

 

We are a Remote First company; however, it is of course much easier to work remotely as a software engineer than a hardware or firmware engineer (since they require access to hardware or devices occasionally). Software engineers based in Stockholm work maybe one day a week or one day every two weeks from the office.

 

We meet a couple of times per year to get to know each other and have fun.

 

Organization and Way of Working

The engineering team is divided into smaller cross functional project teams that each focus on a specific goal or target, where some groups are long-lived, and some are short-lived, depending on how big the goal or deliverable is. We strive to create groups which are cross-functional and able to complete their goals without dependence on other teams, even though this is of course not always possible.

 

Groups track goals on a yearly and quarterly basis with goal follow-up across the entire engineering organization on a bi-weekly basis. Most groups do internal planning on a bi-weekly basis, but in the end it's up to the group to decide how they want to work.

 

We have, however, mandated that all groups must present their progress or failures or hacks at our bi-weekly engineering demo, a fun meeting/presentation where we talk about everything from short-circuiting power-modules, how hard it is to calibrate cameras or align polygons in space, to neat new command line tools for operations, a new auth mechanism in the backend, a cool new way to visualize health data or a new feature which helps our doctors be more productive.

 

We have a flexible workplace that focuses on work/life balance, and we strongly believe in our mission but do not think that achieving it requires sacrificing everything else.

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Us

CIM Software builds manufacturing and ERP software used by manufacturers across the UK and beyond. Our established products, Cim50 and Cim200, are the recommended manufacturing solutions for Sage 50 and Sage 200. We are also developing Cim360.cloud, a new SaaS ERP platform that takes our manufacturing expertise into the cloud.

We were acquired by Everfield in 2025, which gives us the stability and backing of a larger group while keeping the close-knit, hands-on culture of a specialist software company.

About the Role

This is a varied, hands-on role at the heart of a close-knit support desk. You will be one of the people our direct customers and reseller partners turn to when they need help, taking ownership of 1st and 2nd line cases across our full product range. No two days look quite the same: you will resolve what you can yourself and work with the wider team on the trickier problems, building your product knowledge as you go.

We are looking for someone with solid Sage 200 support experience who wants to broaden across our wider product range over time. There is genuine manufacturing ERP expertise to build here, and a clear path to grow as you develop and as we bring Cim360.cloud to market.

AI tooling is part of how we work, and you will be encouraged to use and build your skills with modern AI assistants as part of the day job.

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

Foundation Health is building AI-native pharmacy infrastructure, used by health systems, consumer health brands and pharma manufacturers. We're ~70 people, Series A, and growing quickly across the UK and US — and the operational engine behind the product needs to grow just as fast.

That's where you come in. You'll be the right hand to our BizOps Director, working closely with our COO and with genuine visibility across senior leadership — the work you do here gets seen, used, and built on. You'll pick up the projects that don't fit neatly into any one team and run them from problem framing through to done, and you'll help shape the roadmap for what we take on next, not just deliver what's already on it.

This is a generalist role in the truest sense. We're not looking for someone who's done one thing deeply — we're looking for someone who's done lots of things well, and can pick up whatever comes next. You'll also be working with AI at a depth most companies can't offer: it's the core of what we build and how we work, not something bolted on. And as we scale, this role scales with you — the scope is genuinely yours to grow.

What You'll Be Doing

No two weeks here look the same. Day to day could involve any of the below — and that variety is a big part of what makes the role interesting:

  • Strategic projects — taking a loosely-framed problem, structuring it, doing the analysis, and driving it to implementation — while feeding into the roadmap for where we go next.

  • Procurement & vendor management — sourcing, negotiating with, and managing the tools and vendors that keep the company running — from helpdesk platforms to AI tooling.

  • Contracts & legal — supporting responses to RFIs, RFPs and bids from major US health systems, reviewing agreements, and getting comfortable in the commercial detail.

  • Pricing — understanding what our solutions cost to deliver and modelling what we should sell them at. We’ve built a tiered, usage-based pricing structure from the cost-of-goods up — you’ll help evolve it as the product grows.

  • Commercial & partnerships — supporting sales, client onboarding, and building the collateral and internal tools that help the commercial team move faster.

  • Cross-functional work — partnering with sales, engineering, CX, product, and design to get things over the line.

  • InfoSec & compliance — we operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment with a SOC 2 posture and an active certification programme. You’ll help run controls, policies and third-party risk assessments.
